The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these subtle texture issues, focusing only on gross distortions like noise or blur. alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'bagel' class. The fine_grained_classifier gave a high-confidence prediction (logit 7.98) for 'bagel, beigel', confirming the semantic identity. All testable geometric and functional checkpoints (shape, hole ratio, gloss, toppings) are visually present. The score is deducted slightly from 5.0 due to the subtle 'AI-smoothness' of the crust texture which lacks the rugged imperfection of a real boiled-then-baked bagel, but the structural form is excellent.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifacts are subtle texture inconsistencies and background errors. The background bottle contains nonsensical text/gibberish (Severity ~2.0), a classic AI artifact. The background bagel has a waxy, overly smooth texture compared to the foreground, and the seeds appear slightly fused into the crust rather than sitting on top (Severity ~1.5-2.0). The contact shadow between the two bagels is indistinct, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity (Severity ~1.0). These issues prevent a perfect artifact score, but they do not constitute catastrophic structural failures. The score reflects a high-quality generation with noticeable but non-destructive artifacts.
